- **Upgrading from 1.2.2:** libraries created by 1.2.2 now start on 1.2.4 without a fresh install.
- **A fresh look:** Settings and Jobs are easier to find your way around, with one consistent style across the app.
- **Big libraries feel faster:** Explore, Places, Memories and Activity open quickly on libraries with a million items, and the map groups photos on the server so it stays smooth as you zoom and pan. The map's viewer keeps going past the photos already shown.
- **Automatic updates:** Frameleaf Manager now keeps Frameleaf up to date on its own (you can turn this off), and if an update fails to start it rolls back to the version that worked.
- **Bringing your library over:** imports keep faces, put private items in Locked, finish without machine learning, and setup finishes in more cases. If a file check stops, Retry carries on where it left off, and you can stop setup to let the server run.
- **Setup bar:** says when quiet hours start and counts videos and metadata too.
- **Housekeeping:** the database is tidied up after the nightly cleanup so it stays quick.
- **Windows:** Frameleaf Manager on Windows is more reliable at first run and when backing up Frameleaf Desktop.
